title: E-RLT-0063: the trade table of the isotropic knits, partial: over 1,780 two-generated subgroups of W(F4) up to order...
purpose: Experiment E-RLT-0063 in the relativity arena: the trade table of the isotropic knits, partial: over 1,780 two-generated subgroups of W(F4) up to order 192, the least that forces the husk diffusion and sound through $k^4$ has order 24 (the binary tetrahedral group by left quaternion multiplication, one class, acting freely on the 24 slots) and none below 1,152 forces the husk shear at leading order; the knit built on that group alone gets husk exponents 4.05 (charge), 4.02 (trace), 4.00 (sound) and 0.20 (shear, anisotropy 0.018), W(F4) itself 3.99, 3.98, 3.96, 2.01; the color-exact W(F4) knit keeps exact local color, CPT and the charge law (3.95) but freezes all 12 line momenta, so its shear anisotropy stays 1.47 and its momentum-sector trace is unresolved (2.90 +- 0.50, the registered gate that fails); all four candidates keep CPT, charge, count, momentum and reversal, couple all 66 line pairs, and dress nothing (support 1) with a still vacuum.
known_limitations: Depth L2 (L2: known physics reproduced on a stated model).
